The '''Mankvim-814 light interceptor''', also known as the '''Techno Union starfighter''', or '''Rattletrap''',<ref name="Galaxies">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref> was a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] used by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] near the close of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="CCS" />

==Characteristics==
[[File:Mankvim814_ICS.jpg|thumb|left|180px|Mankvim-814 cross-section.]]

The Mankvim-814's simple construction consisted largely of a reactor feeding power to a high-velocity [[Ion engine/Legends|ion drive]]. A magnetized rudder tilted the ion flow for off-axis thrust, while side thrusters aided roll and yaw adjustments.<ref name="CCS" />

The interceptor was armed with twin rapid-fire [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]] and durable [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shields]] for combat. The Mankvim-814 light interceptor seated one pilot, typically a [[OOM pilot battle droid/Legends|droid pilot]]. The interceptor's aerodynamic wings, fitted with repulsorlifts, aided the overall maneuverability.<ref name="CCS" />

==History==
The Mankvim-814 was a bulbous, oval-shaped, short-range fighter created by the [[Feethan Ottraw Scalable Assemblies/Legends|Feethan Ottraw Scalable Assemblies]] on behalf of the [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]]. The Techno Union built these tiny, short-ranged starfighters on the planet from local materials. They were hastily constructed in the [[Grand Hall of the Traders' Guild/Legends|Grand Halls]] without any regard for Utapau's architectural heritage.<ref name="CCS" />

The model was later given to the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]], where it was used and produced in limited numbers.<ref name="SOTGSE" />

During the [[Battle of Murkhana (Clone Wars)|Battle of Murkhana]] on the final day of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], they were used to combat incoming [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Clone trooper/Legends|forces]].

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a number of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]], used this type of craft for atmospheric travel. The wreck of a crashed Mankvim-814 was found outside of [[Nym's Stronghold]] on [[Lok/Legends|Lok]].<ref name="Galaxies" />

==Behind the scenes==
While ''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith Incredible Cross-Sections]]'' gives the maximum atmospheric speed of the Mankvim-814 as being 62,000 km/h, the later published [[Starship Battles (Star Wars Miniatures)|''Starship Battles'']] Preview 6 gives it as being 1,450 km/h. It is possible that the latter is simply gameplay mechanics. ''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith: The Visual Dictionary]]'' mislabels a picture of a [[Scoop skimmer/Legends|scoop skimmer]] as a Mankvim-814 interceptor.

The Mankvim-814 was introduced to the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]], ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', as part of Chapter 9 in April [[2008]], as a player [[:w:c:swg:Instant Travel Vehicle|instant travel vehicle]].
